invalid configuration: 14 errors
  state_dir: is not an absolute path (fix: use an absolute path, `state_dir = "/var/lib/mayfly"`; `~` and `..` are not expanded)
  github.app_client_id: required, but absent (fix: add `app_client_id = "Iv1.0123456789abcdef"`)
  github.installation_id: 0 is below 1 (fix: use 1 or more)
  github.private_key: not a secret reference: use keychain:<service>/<account>, file:<absolute path>, env:<NAME> or exec:<absolute path>; the config never holds the secret itself (fix: write a reference like `private_key = "file:/etc/mayfly/app-key.pem"`)
  github.organisation: is not a GitHub organisation login (fix: use 1 to 39 letters, digits and hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen)
  github.mode: classic runner registration is not supported (ADR 0028): mayfly serves GitHub Runner Scale Sets only (fix: remove `mode`)
  provider.kind: "qemu" is not a provider (fix: use `kind = "tart"`, the only provider)
  provider.tart_home: required, but absent (fix: add `tart_home = "/var/lib/mayfly/tart"`)
  pools[0].tier: "untrusted" is not supported: v0.x serves the trusted tier only (ADR 0027) (fix: use `tier = "trusted"`)
  pools[0].image_manifest: required, but absent (fix: add `image_manifest = "/etc/mayfly/images/mac.toml"`)
  pools[0].guest_os: "freebsd" is not a guest OS (fix: use `guest_os = "macos"` or `guest_os = "linux"`)
  pools[0].cpu: 0 is outside 1 to 256 (fix: use a value from 1 to 256)
  pools[0].runner_refresh_at: is not a time of day (fix: write `HH:MM` in 24-hour host local time, like `runner_refresh_at = "03:30"`)
  pools[0].allow_untrusted_prs: untrusted pull-request code is not supported in v0.x (ADR 0027), and this switch is never honoured (fix: remove it and give each pool `tier = "trusted"`)
